children: Pitney Bowes reported revenue of $456.18 million and net income of $52.67 million for the quarter, compared with $459.68 million and $51.96 million, respectively, a year earlier. Diluted EPS was $0.37, up from $0.3.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted net income per share”.
Nine-month revenue fell 2%; the company expects full-year 2026 revenue to decline at a low-to-mid-single-digit rate.
SendTech nine-month revenue dipped 1%, while adjusted segment EBIT rose 17%, supported by lower costs and improved gross margin.

Presort nine-month revenue declined 4% amid lower mail volumes and client losses, and adjusted segment EBIT fell 26%. In the third quarter, Presort volumes grew 4% and revenue rose 1%, though higher fuel and transportation costs pressured margins.
Adjusted EBIT is expected to range from a low-single-digit decline to low-single-digit growth, with cost reductions partly offsetting cost and pricing pressures.
